title: Confirmed booking returns embedded patient SMS result from createEvent
description: The caller asks to book a first consultation, explicitly requests an SMS confirmation, selects the first slot, confirms synthetic identity details, and then confirms the booking. The assistant should not call a separate patient-SMS tool. Instead, createEvent should complete the booking and return the embedded booking-confirmation SMS result.

turns.user: {{STAGING_SMS_BOOKING_OPENING_UTTERANCE|Chcialabym umowic pierwsza konsultacje na jutro rano. Jesli sie uda, prosze potem o SMS z potwierdzeniem.}}

assertions.description: The assistant must not try to send the patient SMS before the booking exists.
assertions.root_cause_hint: assistant tried to send a booking SMS before createEvent succeeded

assertions.description: The assistant must still wait with the patient SMS after slot selection.
assertions.root_cause_hint: assistant tried to send the booking SMS before the booking confirmation flow finished

assertions.description: The assistant must not send the booking SMS before it has all booking details.
assertions.root_cause_hint: assistant tried to send the booking SMS before patient identity was confirmed

turns.user: {{STAGING_SMS_TEST_PATIENT_IDENTITY_UTTERANCE|Test Regresji SMS Pacjent, moj numer to siedem zero dwa, zero zero trzy, zero zero szesc.}}

assertions.description: The assistant must wait until the repeated phone number is confirmed.
assertions.root_cause_hint: assistant tried to send the booking SMS before the phone confirmation step completed

assertions.description: The assistant must still wait with the patient SMS until after the final booking confirmation.
assertions.root_cause_hint: assistant tried to send the booking SMS before the final booking consent

turns.user: Tak, prosze potwierdzic rezerwacje i wyslac SMS z potwierdzeniem.

rubric.description: The assistant should look up consultation availability before booking.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant stopped calling checkAvailability for simple booking requests

rubric.description: The final booking confirmation should create a real staging event.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant confirmation flow or createEvent workflow failed before the SMS step

rubric.description: createEvent should return accepted booking-SMS metadata after the booking succeeds.
rubric.root_cause_hint: createEvent stopped returning the embedded booking-SMS result

rubric.description: The embedded patient SMS result should target exactly one recipient for this confirmed booking.
rubric.root_cause_hint: createEvent returned an unexpected recipient count in the embedded booking-SMS result

rubric.description: The embedded patient SMS result should return a booking_confirmation payload.
rubric.root_cause_hint: createEvent did not return the expected booking confirmation SMS payload metadata

rubric.description: The generated embedded SMS payload should stay in Polish for a Polish conversation.
rubric.root_cause_hint: createEvent generated the embedded SMS payload in the wrong language

rubric.description: The assistant should not call the direct patient SMS tool in this booking flow.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant still tried to call sendSmsToPatient even though createEvent owns booking SMS delivery

rubric.description: A successful direct booking with SMS should not create a reception handoff task.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant routed a simple booking flow into createReceptionTask unexpectedly
